intro: One playthrough is enough, but there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus — so keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter. The only thing that can be missed is the first meditation in Chapter 1. Everything else stays available in free roam after the story, and the 100% checklist only appears after the credits (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion), though earlier progress already counts.

stages.detail: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing, then Chapters 1–4 and the final mission. Story trophies unlock as you go. Do the balcony meditation in Chapter 1 before you leave it, and take the optional Chapter 4 mission “That’s Where The Money Is…” when it appears — it unlocks the bank vaults.
stages.title: 1 · Play the story

stages.detail: Stranger mission strands open across Leonida as the story progresses. Finish any eight strands, plus the final missions for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone.
stages.title: 2 · Strangers & Freaks

stages.detail: The long grind: 250 stunts, 42 shooting-range golds, drone races at all 14 Top Fun locations, 20 different race wins, fishing, arcade games, 50 challenges, robberies and combat feats. Most of these also feed the 100% checklist.
stages.title: 3 · Activities & challenges

stages.detail: Meditate at all 18 spots, hunt Bret’s unique animal, finish 3 card sets, WAiNK-scan 100 locations, discover 100 vehicles and uncover the whole map of Leonida.
stages.title: 4 · Collectibles & exploration

stages.detail: Partner robberies, laundering $250,000 of Marked Bills, spending $100,000 in shops, buying all 8 garages and registering 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app.
stages.title: 5 · Money & property

stages.detail: Open the 100% checklist after the credits and mop up whatever it still lists — then A Long Road pops, and with it the platinum.
stages.title: 6 · 100% & platinum
